98    /**
99     * National Personal Identity number (tc kimlik no)
100     *
101     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkish_Identification_Number
102     *
103     * @return string on format XXXXXXXXXXX
104     */
105    public function tcNo()
106    {
107        $randomDigits = static::numerify('#########');
108        $checksum = self::tcNoChecksum($randomDigits);
109
110        return $randomDigits . $checksum;
111    }
112
113    /**
114     * Generates Turkish Identity Number Checksum
115     * Gets first 9 digit as prefix and calculates checksum
116     *
117     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkish_Identification_Number
118     *
119     * @param string $identityPrefix
120     *
121     * @return string Checksum (two digit)
122     */
123    public static function tcNoChecksum($identityPrefix)
124    {
125        if (strlen((string) $identityPrefix) !== 9) {
126            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Argument should be an integer and should be 9 digits.');
127        }
128
129        $oddSum = 0;
130        $evenSum = 0;
131
132        $identityArray = array_map('intval', str_split($identityPrefix)); // Creates array from int
133
134        foreach ($identityArray as $index => $digit) {
135            if ($index % 2 === 0) {
136                $evenSum += $digit;
137            } else {
138                $oddSum += $digit;
139            }
140        }
141
142        $tenthDigit = (7 * $evenSum - $oddSum) % 10;
143        $eleventhDigit = ($evenSum + $oddSum + $tenthDigit) % 10;
144
145        return $tenthDigit . $eleventhDigit;
146    }
147
148    /**
149     * Checks whether a TCNo has a valid checksum
150     *
151     * @param string $tcNo
152     *
153     * @return bool
154     */
155    public static function tcNoIsValid($tcNo)
156    {
157        return self::tcNoChecksum(substr($tcNo, 0, -2)) === substr($tcNo, -2, 2);
158    }
